text:
Lindsey (sales): quick help — Contoso's vendor risk team sent a SIG with a BCP/DR section. They want RTO/RPO, backups, failover, SLA bullets we can put in the questionnaire.
Marco (security): got it. Short bullets ok. I'll list controlled statements + links to evidence.
Tom (eng-runtime): For hosted API: SLA 99.9% (SLA doc link). Control plane recoveries: typical control-plane failover < 5m, regional runtime failover using warm replicas < 3m for in-flight requests reroute. RTO depends on model warming (KV warmup) — cold-start to steady throughput ~ 20-30m.
Alex (sales-eng): can we put concrete RTO numbers? Contoso insisted on max RTO for critical paths.
Marco (security): we should split by deployment: Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Hosted: RTO (control path) <= 5m, RTO (full steady-state for model serving) <= 30m, RPO for customer data: near-zero for auth and config (replicated), for caches KV is ephemeral (acceptable loss). We'll phrase: "RTO: control-plane < 5m; service reestablished < 30m; RPO: critical metadata <1m; ephemeral caches: best-effort".
Priya (sre): backups: nightly full config snapshots + continuous incremental of metadata to S3 cross-region encrypted (AES-256), keys in KMS. Recovery drill quarterly; last drill 2026-01-15 (simulated region outage). Restore time from snapshot for control-plane config ~ 10-15m in our drills.
Lindsey (sales): thanks — can you add the exact phrasing for SIG CAIQ? They want short yes/no + evidence links.
Marco (security): draft for SIG: "We maintain documented BCP/DR policies, quarterly DR exercises, cross-region replication for critical metadata, encrypted backups, and SLA-backed failover policies. RTO commitments vary by deployment: Hosted control-plane <5m, service <30m; Dedicated SLA per contract; Private: depends on customer infra; see evidence links." I'll attach evidences.
drill-bot: [automated] DR drill log uploaded: go/internal/drill-2026-01-15 (link)
Tom (eng-runtime): failover details: automated routing via smart-routing layer, health checks at 5s intervals, connection draining, live warm replicas with KV cache sync on steady-state; for Dedicated, customers can configure cross-availability-zone replication and preferred fallback.
Alex (sales-eng): pricing/customer asks: will Dedicated include DR options? Yes — dedicated can have reserved capacity in two AZs/regions as add-on; we'll include options in the pricing sheet.
Lindsey (sales): perfect. Marco, can you push a short SIG answer set (3-4 bullets + links) in this thread so I can paste into the form?
Marco (security): will do, next message.
Marco (security): SIG-ready bullets:
- "BCP/DR program: documented, annually reviewed; quarterly tabletop and failover drills (evidence: go/internal/drill-2026-01-15)"
- "Recovery Objectives: Hosted control-plane RTO <5 minutes; hosted service to steady-state RTO <30 minutes; RPO for critical metadata <1 minute; ephemeral caches are best-effort"
- "Backups & Replication: Continuous incremental and nightly snapshots stored cross-region, encrypted at rest with KMS; restoration playbooks available (evidence: go/internal/backups-playbook)"
- "Failover & SLA: Automated health checks, routing, and warm replicas for fast failover; production SLA available in contract (evidence: go/internal/sla-page)"
Marco (security): tagging @Lindsey — paste these into SIG field and attach evidence links.
Lindsey (sales): done, sent to Contoso. Thanks all :tada:
Priya (sre): note for follow-up: schedule next quarterly drill invite to Contoso if they request a joint drill.
Alex (sales-eng): adding that to our action items list.
